theorems.name: ATK.NavierStokes.absorption
theorems.statement: ∀ {ν z y y' B T R cB cT C : ℝ},   y' / 2 + ν * z ≤ B + T + R →     B ≤ cB * ν * z → T ≤ cT * ν * z → R ≤ C * y ^ 2 → y' / 2 + (1 - cB - cT) * ν * z ≤ C * y ^ 2

theorems.name: ATK.NavierStokes.absorption_margin_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ {cB cT : ℝ}, cB + cT < 1 → 0 < 1 - cB - cT

theorems.name: ATK.NavierStokes.riccati_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ {y y' : ℝ → ℝ} {C T : ℝ},   0 ≤ T →     (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, 0 < y t) →       (∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt y (y' t) t) →         (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, y' t ≤ 2 * C * y t ^ 2) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (y 0)⁻¹ - 2 * C * t ≤ (y t)⁻¹

theorems.name: ATK.NavierStokes.riccati_upper_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ {y y' : ℝ → ℝ} {C T t : ℝ},   0 ≤ T →     (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, 0 < y s) →       (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt y (y' s) s) →         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, y' s ≤ 2 * C * y s ^ 2) →           t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T → 0 < 1 - 2 * C * y 0 * t → y t ≤ y 0 / (1 - 2 * C * y 0 * t)
